resources.string: Approve individual Home screen icons during a batch you start

After you start an app shortcut batch in Hail, this optional service reads your launcher’s Add to Home screen confirmation and taps its Add button for each selected app. It acts only while that batch is active and stops if it cannot identify the confirmation. It does not read other apps, collect or transmit screen contents, or grant permissions. You can stop the batch at any time or disable this service here. Some launchers require manual confirmation.
Shortcut assistant disconnected. Enable it in Accessibility settings, then resume the batch.
Shortcut assistant interrupted. Resume the batch when you are ready.
Batch paused because the screen locked. Unlock your device, then resume.
The launcher’s Add confirmation could not be identified safely. Confirm it yourself or continue in manual mode.
The launcher did not accept the Add action. Confirm it yourself or retry this app.
Batch paused because another screen opened. Return to Hail to resume.
The Add confirmation closed without an automatic approval. Return to Hail to resume or skip this app.
